verses.en: Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.
verses.pt: A ti, SENHOR, levanto minha alma.
verses.en_web: To you, Yahweh, do I lift up my soul.
verses.en_bbe: <Of David.> To you, O Lord, my soul is lifted up.

verses.en: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.
verses.pt: Meu Deus, eu confio em ti; não me deixes envergonhado, nem que meus inimigos se alegrem por me vencerem.
verses.en_web: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
verses.en_bbe: O my God, I have put my faith in you, let me not be shamed; let not my haters be glorying over me.

verses.en: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
verses.pt: Certamente todos os que esperam em ti, nenhum será envergonhado; envergonhados serão os que traem sem motivo.
verses.en_web: Yes, no one who waits for you shall be shamed. They shall be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
verses.en_bbe: Let no servant of yours be put to shame; may those be shamed who are false without cause.

verses.en: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.
verses.pt: Tu me fazes conhecer os teus caminhos; ensina-me teus lugares onde se deve andar.
verses.en_web: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
verses.en_bbe: Make your steps clear to me, O Lord; give me knowledge of your ways.

verses.en: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
verses.pt: Guia-me em tua verdade, e ensina-me; porque tu és o Deus de minha salvação; eu espero por ti o dia todo.
verses.en_web: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.
verses.en_bbe: Be my guide and teacher in the true way; for you are the God of my salvation; I am waiting for your word all the day.

verses.en: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.
verses.pt: Lembra-te, SENHOR, de tuas misericórdias e de tuas bondades; porque elas são desde a eternidade.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, keep in mind your pity and your mercies; for they have been from the earliest times.

verses.en: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness’ sake, O LORD.
verses.pt: Não te lembres dos pecados de minha juventude e das minhas transgressões; mas sim, conforme tua misericórdia, lembra-te de mim por tua bondade, SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Do not keep in mind my sins when I was young, or my wrongdoing: let your memory of me be full of mercy, O Lord, because of your righteousness.

verses.en: Good and upright is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
verses.pt: O SENHOR é bom e correto; por isso ele ensinará o caminho aos pecadores.
verses.en_web: Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
verses.en_bbe: Good and upright is the Lord: so he will be the teacher of sinners in the way.

verses.en: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
verses.pt: Ele guiará os humildes ao bom juízo; e ensinará aos humildes seu caminho.
verses.en_web: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
verses.en_bbe: He will be an upright guide to the poor in spirit: he will make his way clear to them.

verses.en: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.pt: Todos os caminhos do SENHOR são bondade e verdade, para aqueles que guardam seu pacto e seus testemunhos.
verses.en_web: All the paths of Yahweh are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.en_bbe: All the ways of the Lord are mercy and good faith for those who keep his agreement and his witness.

verses.en: For thy name’s sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.
verses.pt: Pelo teu nome, SENHOR, perdoa a minha maldade, porque ela é grande.
verses.en_web: For your name’s sake, Yahweh, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
verses.en_bbe: Because of your name, O Lord, let me have forgiveness for my sin, which is very great.

verses.en: What man is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.
verses.pt: Qual é o homem que teme ao SENHOR? Ele lhe ensinará o caminho que deve escolher.
verses.en_web: What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
verses.en_bbe: If a man has the fear of the Lord, the Lord will be his teacher in the way of his pleasure.

verses.en: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
verses.pt: Sua alma habitará no bem; e sua semente isto é, sua descendência possuirá a terra em herança.
verses.en_web: His soul shall dwell at ease. His offspring shall inherit the land.
verses.en_bbe: His soul will be full of good things, and his seed will have the earth for its heritage.

verses.en: The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.
verses.pt: O segredo do SENHOR é para os que o temem; e ele lhes faz conhecer seu pacto.
verses.en_web: The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
verses.en_bbe: The secret of the Lord is with those in whose hearts is the fear of him; he will make his agreement clear to them.

verses.en: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.pt: Meus olhos estão continuamente voltados para o SENHOR, porque ele tirará meus pés da rede de caça.
verses.en_web: My eyes are ever on Yahweh, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.en_bbe: My eyes are turned to the Lord at all times; for he will take my feet out of the net.

verses.en: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
verses.pt: Olha para mim, e mim, e tem piedade de mim, porque eu estou solitário e miserável.
verses.en_web: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
verses.en_bbe: Be turned to me, and have mercy on me; for I am troubled and have no helper.

verses.en: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.
verses.pt: As aflições de meu coração têm se multiplicado; tira-me de minhas angústias.
verses.en_web: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
verses.en_bbe: The troubles of my heart are increased: O take me out of my sorrows.

verses.en: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
verses.pt: Presta atenção para minha miséria e meu cansativo trabalho; e tira todos os meus pecados.
verses.en_web: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
verses.en_bbe: Give thought to my grief and my pain; and take away all my sins.

verses.en: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.
verses.pt: Presta atenção a meus inimigos, porque eles estão se multiplicando; eles me odeiam com ódio violento.
verses.en_web: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
verses.en_bbe: See how those who are against me are increased, for bitter is their hate of me.

verses.en: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.
verses.pt: Guarda minha alma, e livra-me; não me deixes envergonhado, porque eu confio em ti.
verses.en_web: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.
verses.en_bbe: O keep my soul, and take me out of danger: let me not be shamed, for I have put my faith in you.

verses.en: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
verses.pt: Integridade e justiça me guardem, porque eu espero em ti.
verses.en_web: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
verses.en_bbe: For my clean and upright ways keep me safe, because my hope is in you.

verses.en: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
verses.pt: Ó Deus, resgata Israel de todas as suas angústias. Salmo de Davi:
verses.en_web: Redeem Israel, God, out of all his troubles.
verses.en_bbe: Give Israel salvation, O God, out of all his troubles.
